description: This file defines a Commands class for interacting with a WebView component in a React Native app, providing methods to send commands, focus, blur, insert images, manage settings, and handle internal links within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Commands
classes.description: A class providing methods to control and communicate with a WebView for editing notes.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Sends a JavaScript job to the WebView and awaits a response.

methods.name: fn
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript function string with error handling for injection into WebView.

methods.name: doAsync
methods.description: Executes a JavaScript job asynchronously in the WebView.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with arguments to the WebView.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the editor tab, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Blurs the editor tab.

methods.name: clearContent
methods.description: Clears the content of the editor.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Sets the session ID for the editor.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the editor with date and save info.

methods.name: setPlaceholder
methods.description: Sets placeholder text (empty implementation).

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading state of the editor.

methods.name: setInsets
methods.description: Sets safe area insets.

methods.name: updateSettings
methods.description: Updates editor settings.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets editor settings, with previous settings fallback.

methods.name: setTags
methods.description: Sets tags for a note across tabs.

methods.name: clearTags
methods.description: Clears tags for a specific tab.

methods.name: insertAttachment
methods.description: Inserts an attachment into the editor.

methods.name: setAttachmentProgress
methods.description: Updates attachment upload progress.

methods.name: insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image into the editor.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Handles back navigation.

methods.name: keyboardShown
methods.description: Notifies about keyboard visibility.

methods.name: getTableOfContents
methods.description: Retrieves the table of contents.

methods.name: focusPassInput
methods.description: Focuses the password input.

methods.name: blurPassInput
methods.description: Blurs the password input.

methods.name: createInternalLink
methods.description: Creates an internal link.

methods.name: dismissCreateInternalLinkRequest
methods.description: Dismisses internal link creation request.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewById
methods.description: Scrolls to an element by ID.

methods.name: scrollToSearchResult
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific search result index.
